scripts.sanity:api: start-server-and-test "npm --workspace backend run start:dev" http-get://localhost:3000/health "curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/api/seed && curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/api/examples && echo '✅ Backend & DB OK'"
scripts.sanity:web: start-server-and-test "npm --workspace frontend run dev" http://localhost:5173 "echo '✅ Frontend OK at http://localhost:5173'"
scripts.sanity: npm run setup && npm run sanity:api && npm run sanity:web
scripts.up: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.key:export:
node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import bs58 from 'bs58'; import {Keypair} from '@solana/web3.js'; const keyPath=process.argv[2]||'./mainnet-keypair.json'; if(!fs.existsSync(keyPath)){console.error('Keypair file not found:',keyPath); process.exit(1);} const arr=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(keyPath,'utf8')); const secret=Uint8Array.from(arr); const b58=bs58.encode(secret); const pub=Keypair.fromSecretKey(secret).publicKey.toBase58(); const envPath='.env'; let env=fs.existsSync(envPath)?fs.readFileSync(envPath,'utf8'):''; const prefix='SECRET_KEY_BASE58='; const outLines=env.split('
').filter(l=>!l.startsWith(prefix) && l.trim().length>0); outLines.push(prefix+b58); fs.writeFileSync(envPath,outLines.join('
')+'
','utf8'); console.log('Wrote SECRET_KEY_BASE58 to .env'); console.log('Public key:', pub);"
